scope: Independent bounded review of the six preserved bibliography blocks, all 312 citation groups and occurrence records, the 107 recovered records, and the scope note. This is a discovery-integrity review, not discovered-work identity resolution, eligibility adjudication, method coding, recursive expansion, or global coverage certification.

Independently removed only observed page layout and web locator prefixes from each raw span. All 312 resulting texts match group bibliography_verbatim exactly; removal of only the leading reference label yields all 312 occurrence bibliography_verbatim fields exactly. Display whitespace normalization also agrees.

All parent DOIs, document IDs, group joins, ordinal sequences and occurrence locators agree. Local PDF pages were independently read from source-text page markers; Lee web lines and zero-based to one-based page conversion agree.

All 108 explicit DOI source fragments occur literally in their own citation text and yield the recorded DOI under the stated whitespace/resolver-prefix/terminal-period rule. No unindexed DOI-like string occurs in the remaining citation texts. Parent DOI footer strings are excluded. DOI identity or validity is not established by this check.
All 16 available PDF/fulltext/block hashes and all six access/protocol/base-eligibility evidence pins match their recorded values.

All 107 completed occurrence records were read, including Neto SI 32–67, Dickens SI 1–4, and Lee 1–67. Text, DOI provenance, layout handling, source links, statuses and locators agree with the frozen group evidence. Their empty flags lists remain historical; anomalies noted below are additive review observations.

All 312 occurrences remain discovery_generation=1, UNRESOLVED_NO_EXTERNAL_LOOKUP, NOT_SCREENED and NOT_CODED. No binary method codes or recursive source expansion appear. Counts describe citation groups/occurrences, not unique papers.

The scope note matches the counts, boundary traps, source identities, extraction limitations and access gaps. Lee local PDF/text hashes remain null; five Lim supplemental files and the Lee supplement remain uninspected. No full bundle, population freeze, P-LIT proportion or verdict is claimed.
